thread:
Maria (CS): heads up — customer reports records that should have been purged during the retention cutover are still showing up in search results. they need a preservation window for an audit tomorrow. can we pause deletes for their org?
Alex M: which org and what cutover time?
Maria (CS): Org: Brightline Corp (org_4932). Cutover applied 2026-03-12 00:00 UTC. They claim objects with tombstone timestamps ~= 2026-03-12 02:12 still returned by /v1/search.
Priya R: tagging infra — do we have visibility on the deletion queue processing for that org? any backlog?
Tony (Infra): looking. deletion-worker-3 shows steady throughput, but I see intermittent HSM key errors around 2026-03-12 02:10-02:14 in the logs: "kms:decrypt failed: transient_unavailable". That could block tombstone finalization if decryption required for verification.
Sam T: if KMS decryption fails we normally queue and retry — shouldn't surface in search though. search index might still have entries if tombstones weren't propagated to indexer. can you share a sample object id?
Maria (CS): obj: obj_8b7f4e93. Repro steps provided by customer: 1) Upload object 2) Set retention policy to default 30d 3) System applied cutover 4) Query /v1/search?q=obj_8b7f4e93 and result present.
Alex M: can you paste the raw search response?
Maria (CS): pasted (sanitized): ```{\n  "hits": [ { "id": "obj_8b7f4e93", "created": "2026-02-10T11:23:00Z", "tombstone": "2026-03-12T02:12:00Z", "visible": true } ]\n}```
Priya R: ok — two likely areas: 1) tombstone not propagated to search index (index lag) 2) storage deletion not completed due to KMS transient errors so indexer kept it alive. Tony, can you check indexer logs around 02:12?
Tony (Infra): indexer-2 logs: successful tombstone update for obj_8b7f4e93 at 02:12:08, pushed to ES shard s-4. However, ES returned 200 but with partial shard failure noted right after — looks like s-4 had a transient unassigned shard at 02:12:10. ES later recovered.
Sam T: that matches a race: tombstone reached indexer but ES failed to update one shard; by the time ES recovered, the object was still readable from the search replica. Usually recoveries reconcile, but with a retention cutover we must be careful.
Maria (CS): customer needs assurance: they have subpoena tomorrow and want a 48h preservation hold. can we apply a hold to prevent deletions/compactions and guarantee an export?
Alex M: short answer: yes, we can apply a preservation hold flag at the org level which prevents the deletion pipeline and marks objects frozen. that needs approval from Legal Ops and an ops runbook step.
Legal Ops: please confirm scope — preservation hold will suspend final deletes and compaction for all objects under org_4932. It will also freeze any scheduled background purges. Customer will still be billed for storage.
Priya R: action items: 1) Apply preservation hold (manual toggle) 2) Kick off emergency export job to generate object bundle and audit log snapshot 3) Increase retention of audit logs to 180 days for compliance review 4) Investigate KMS transient errors and ES shard flapping root cause.
Tony (Infra): I'll apply hold to org_4932 now (steps: set org.metadata.preservation_hold=true -> run config refresh -> pause delete-workers for org_4932). Doing it in 2 mins and will post confirmation.
RetentionBot: automated note: preservation_hold set to true for org_4932 by Tony (Infra) at 2179991450. Delete-workers paused for org_4932.
Maria (CS): thanks. customer also asked whether custom retention policies override the default at cutover time — want wording we can send them.
Alex M: send: "Default retention applies only when no custom retention policy is set on an object or bucket. When a custom retention exists it takes precedence. During cutover we evaluate per-object policies; objects with active custom retention will not be deleted even if default rules change."
Sam T: follow-up — we should include note about KMS: if the customer's key is in rotation or unavailable, finalization may be delayed. if they require guaranteed availability for legal exports, recommend they provide a key rotation window or temporarily allow Redwood-managed key for the export.
Legal Ops: approve preservation hold. Legal requests audit_log export and HSM key usage report.
Maria (CS): I'll schedule the export and share ETA with the customer. Tony, please open a JIRA to investigate ES shard instability + KMS transient failures and tag it HIGH.
Tony (Infra): opened INFRA-7429, assigned to sam_t, priority P0.
Sam T: noted. I'll gather logs and reproduce locally. initial hypothesis: ES rolling-rebalance coincided with heavy indexing from cutover window. also looking at network outages for shard s-4.
Maria (CS): closing loop — preservation hold applied, export queued, customer notified. will keep thread updated. :white_check_mark:
